$comment: The fifteen demo cases of the policy servicing desk: eight change requests and seven certificate requests. The desk lists the newest case first, so the file is written last to first. Everything is invented: Thornmere Mutual Insurance, its policyholders, its policies and the certificate holders. Every id, date and amount is what the invented insurer returns when it is started with the date 26 November 2026.

cases.title: Venn, sum insured for the vehicle and a waiver: certificate
cases.text:
THE REQUEST
Request: CRQ-7407
Policy: POL-2011, private motor
Holder: Isaura Venn
Asked by: Isaura Venn, policyholder
Received: 25 Nov 2026
For: Candlewick Parking Company Ltd, Candlewick Street Car Park, Marlow Reach, Meridia
Dated: 26 Nov 2026
Must show: sum insured for the vehicle; a waiver of rights of recovery against Candlewick Parking Company Ltd
IN THE REQUESTER'S WORDS
The car park I use asks for a certificate dated 26 Nov 2026 that shows the sum insured for my car and says that Thornmere waives its rights of recovery against Candlewick Parking Company Ltd. Isaura Venn
THE AGENT'S TASK
The agent prepares the certificate from the insurer's template and from the policy as it stands on the certificate date, and says where the request asks for something the policy does not hold. It issues nothing, changes no policy and contacts nobody. The servicing officer reads every draft and issues the document. Everything here is as the servicing system holds it. The agent reads the certificate request itself from the servicing system.

THE REQUEST
Request: CHG-7308
Policy: POL-2011, private motor
Holder: Isaura Venn
Asked by: Isaura Venn, policyholder, by email
Received: 25 Nov 2026
Change: Change of sum insured, from 29 Nov 2026
IN THE REQUESTER'S WORDS
Please raise the sum insured on my car from 19,500.00 to 23,400.00 from 29 Nov 2026. A valuation came in higher. Isaura Venn
THE AGENT'S TASK
The agent sets out what is asked, which numbered servicing rule it touches, the premium adjustment as the servicing system worked it out, and any gap in cover. It changes no policy, charges and returns no premium, cancels nothing and contacts nobody. The servicing officer decides and makes the change. Where a rule asks for a referral, underwriting or the servicing team leader reads the request first. Everything here is as the servicing system holds it. The agent reads the change request itself from the servicing system.
